description: Integrated candidate feeds only. Candidate indexes are leads; neither a directory record nor an entity credit proves an employer's current game-development status or acceptance of speculative applications.

sources.label: Wikidata: video game developer entities
sources.coverage: Entities classified as video-game developers. Classification and official identity require independent verification.
sources.pagination: QID cursor; a completed pass restarts from the beginning for incremental discovery.

access.retry_policy: One bounded Retry-After retry for HTTP 429; stop safely when the requested delay is too long or a second 429 occurs.

sources.label: Wikidata: organizations credited as video-game developers
sources.coverage: Organizations recorded in video-game developer credits. Credits are candidate signals, not sufficient proof of current development activity.
sources.pagination: QID cursor; a completed pass restarts from the beginning for incremental discovery.

access.retry_policy: One bounded Retry-After retry for HTTP 429; stop safely when the requested delay is too long or a second 429 occurs.

sources.label: Wikidata: video-game company entities
sources.coverage: Entities classified as video-game companies. Company entities may be publishers, parents or mixed organisations and require careful classification.
sources.pagination: QID cursor; a completed pass restarts from the beginning for incremental discovery.

access.retry_policy: One bounded Retry-After retry for HTTP 429; stop safely when the requested delay is too long or a second 429 occurs.

sources.label: Wikidata: companies classified in the video-game industry
sources.coverage: Broad industry classification used only as a lead. It includes publishers, vendors and other ecosystem organisations; the employer site must demonstrate direct game-development work before automatic publication.
sources.pagination: QID cursor; a completed pass restarts from the beginning for incremental discovery.

access.retry_policy: One bounded Retry-After retry for HTTP 429; stop safely when the requested delay is too long or a second 429 occurs.

sources.label: GameDevMap: public worldwide studio directory
sources.coverage: Public worldwide directory. Rows may represent multiple offices, publishers or other entities; classification and deduplication are required. Catalogue size is not a unique-studio count.
sources.pagination: Numeric start offset; 100 raw rows per page. Persist the offset during a pass, then restart at 1 after reaching the catalogue end so new monthly entries are revisited.

access.request_policy: Use the existing fetch_url implementation, which enforces robots.txt, public-host validation and per-host request spacing. Do not use raw data files or bypass access controls.
access.terms_review: Re-check current terms and permitted reuse before expanding collection or republishing additional source fields.
access.refresh_note: GameDevMap describes monthly data drops; recurring full passes revisit the public paginated catalogue.

sources.label: IGDB: companies with developed-game credits
sources.coverage: IGDB company records with one or more developed-game credits and an official company website. Publisher/developer hybrids may appear; company records are candidate evidence, not proof of an active studio or an application route.
sources.pagination: Numeric IGDB company ID cursor; raw company rows determine page completion, even when a row cannot be normalized to a safe official website.

access.authentication: Twitch client-credentials app access token, minted at run time.
access.website_type_lookup: Resolve the official website type dynamically from /v4/website_types; do not hard-code the deprecated company_website.category enum.
access.request_policy: Use server-side GitHub Actions secrets only. Never expose credentials in logs, generated files or the public website. Candidate URLs are independently verified before publishing.

sources.label: Scottish Games Industry: open company directory
sources.coverage: Community-maintained Scottish games-company dataset. The adapter selects active developer and solo-developer categories with official websites; every candidate must independently prove direct game development and an explicit speculative application route on the employer-controlled site.
sources.pagination: Git tree index of data/companies/*.json; numeric offset over sorted raw company files. Raw file count, not filtered candidate count, determines page completion.
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for company data. Retain attribution and source provenance; non-commercial use only; share-alike applies. Obtain separate permission before any commercial use.
sources.attribution: Scottish Games Industry company dataset, r0bbie/gamesindustry.scot

access.method: Public GitHub API and raw JSON files; no API key required for public repository reads.
access.request_policy: Use the public Git tree and raw company JSON records only; respect robots.txt, public-host validation and per-host spacing in fetch_url. Keep CC BY-NC-SA attribution and non-commercial boundary.
